name: kestrel-desktop
comment: Quickshell and compositor-adjacent work. Hint 1 or the kestrel-desktop class cgroup.

name: kestrel-term
comment: Interactive terminals (Ghostty). Hint 2 or the kestrel-term class cgroup.

name: kestrel-browser-active
comment: Focused browser process. Hint 3 or the browser active bucket.

name: kestrel-browser-background
comment: Unfocused browser processes. Hint 4 or the browser background bucket.

name: kestrel-game
comment: Games. Hint 5 or the kestrel-game class cgroup.

name: default
comment: Everything the broker has not classified stays on plain scx_layered scheduling.
